🇲🇽🌎 <u>ZÓCALO FAN FEST: 576K VISITORS, 322 MDP IN 7 DAYS — MEXICO IS THE WORLD'S HOST CITY</u>

Canaco CDMX: the FIFA Fan Fest at the Zócalo has accumulated more than 576,000 visitors in its first week, averaging 82,400 people per day — making it the most-attended alternate venue of the entire tournament. Economic spillover already past 322.8 million pesos, with each attendee spending between 560 and 1,150 pesos on food and drinks. Canaco projects the full Mundial 2026 will leave 26.28 BILLION pesos in CDMX alone.

Three hosts, but Mexico is moving the crowds. The Zócalo — once the heart of Tenochtitlan — is now the heart of the world's biggest sporting event. Free. Public. Mexican.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>TRUMP'S WEAPON ISN'T A GUN — IT'S CONFUSION, ENGINEERED AT INDUSTRIAL SCALE</u>

Philosopher Fernando Buen Abad in Contralínea (June 17): "Confusion thereby acquires strategic function… Trump understood induced confusion as a decisively destructive force." It's not noise — it's strategy. Constant scandals displace reasoned deliberation with emotional reactivity, dismantling the public's capacity to identify cause and effect or assign historical responsibility for inequality. The infrastructure: tech corporations, media conglomerates, algorithms, data consultancies, all operating at planetary scale.

When Sheinbaum tells reporters Trump is "not well informed" and walks past the bait, she's naming the tactic — refusing to fall into it. Same playbook deployed against Dilma in 2014 Brazil, against Correa in Ecuador, against AMLO before 2018. Mexico has read this book before.

🇲🇽🔥 <u>SCJN: GUARDERIA ABC CRIMES NEVER EXPIRE — SHEINBAUM SAYS THE NEW JUDICIARY DELIVERED</u>

17 years after 49 children burned to death at a privatized IMSS daycare in Hermosillo, Mexico's Supreme Court ruled unanimously that the crimes can never expire. Sheinbaum: "This is thanks to the change in the Judicial Branch — otherwise it would never have happened." Minister Estela Ríos pinned the blame on the neoliberal model itself: "yes, there was state responsibility, because the State was the one that privatized daycare service." Calderón-era ex-IMSS official Sergio Salazar tried to dodge under statute of limitations — court said no.

The "judicial coup" the right shrieked about is the same reform that just gave 49 dead babies their day in court. The model that killed them was the one that sold off public services to private friends — and that model is still on trial.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>MINING UNION: NARCO IN MEXICAN MINES IS "A CANCER PROMOTED BY FOREIGN CAPITAL"</u>

At a seminar at the Autonomous University of Zacatecas on June 19, Sindicato Minero lawyer Óscar Alzaga Sánchez named the disease: "the intervention of organized crime in the country's mining sector has become a cancer promoted by foreign capital, especially by Canadian and American companies." Two cases in Zacatecas alone — Camino Rojo (Canada's Orla Mining) and Peñasquito (US Newmont). A T-MEC panel already confirmed Camino Rojo hired drug traffickers since May 2024 to break union meetings, issue death threats, and force workers into a company-friendly union.

Napoleón Gómez Urrutia adds the list keeps growing: Plata Panamericana, Américas Gold and Silver in Cosalá, Torex Gold in Guerrero. This is what "free trade" looks like when the cartels work for the boardroom.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>SHEINBAUM BACKS CUBA'S ECONOMIC OPENING — "AN IMPORTANT CHANGE"</u>

At Friday's mañanera (June 19), Sheinbaum welcomed Cuba's National Assembly vote to authorize private companies over 100 employees, foreign capital in the private sector, and foreign-currency accounts for individuals: "It is an important change the decision that Cubans make to open their economy. They are doing it for investment, even calling on Cubans who left the island a long time ago to invest in Cuba." Mexican businesses interested in investing will get Cancillería support to make contacts.

This is Latin solidarity in action while the EU Parliament voted the same week to sanction Díaz-Canel and the US Nimitz strike group still sits in the Caribbean. Mexico recognizes Cuba's sovereign right to reform its own economy — not Washington's right to dictate it.

FORTUNE / AP: "All of This Should Prompt Reflection" — Sheinbaum Says World Cup Tickets Too Expensive for Most Mexicans
June 15, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Straight AP coverage of Sheinbaum's FIFA critique. No "populist gesture" sneer, no anonymous-analyst hand-wringing — quotes her on social vs. commercial sport, notes her free public-viewing alternative, and reports she gave her opening-match ticket to an Indigenous female player. 🇲🇽

This is what fair coverage looks like. Worth flagging precisely because it is rare.

• "Soccer has to be something else"
• "All of this should prompt reflection, even within FIFA"
• Soccer should be "a space for bringing people together, like all sports"

MEXICO NEWS DAILY: Sheinbaum Sidesteps Report on Cartel Slave Labor
June 18, 2026 | 🟡

📰 The US-owned English-language MND frames Sheinbaum as ducking a Quinto Elemento Lab investigation into Sierra Tarahumara forced-labor camps where men were lured by fake job offers, then guarded at gunpoint in poppy and marijuana fields. 🔍

The report itself dates the abuses to a period that "continued until 2024" — predating her government — but the headline puts the failure on her. Her actual response, buried below the lede: federal welfare programs, road construction, and National Guard deployment in the region.

• Headline verb: "sidesteps"
• Sheinbaum: "The state is present in many spheres of national life"
• Investigation by Mexican outlet Quinto Elemento Lab, May 2026 — up to 300 men reportedly tortured, starved

THE HILL (opinion): An Operation Targeting Tren de Aragua Sends a Stern Message to Mexico
June 17, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Op-ed celebrates a US "swift and lethal kinetic strike" that killed Tren de Aragua's alleged leader in Venezuela — then frames it as a warning to Sheinbaum. Translation: assassinate first, ask sovereignty questions later. 💀

The piece treats Mexico's constitutional refusal of US lethal operations as obstruction to be overcome, not law to be respected.

• "stern message to Mexico, a country that has opposed similar operations"
• Trump quoted approvingly on "bloodthirsty Terrorist Organizations on Planet Earth"
• Extrajudicial killing in Venezuela framed as the new US playbook for Latin America

LATIN TIMES / MND: Vance: US Reserves "The Right" to Take Military Action Against Cartels in Mexico
June 17–18, 2026 | 🔴

📰 VP JD Vance on N+ Univision: "We would take military action if we feel like we have to protect our people." Same week Trump told the G7 cartels run Mexico and called Sheinbaum "a scared woman." Two officials, one script — invasion normalized as bipartisan US right.

Sheinbaum delivered her annual address explicitly rejecting the framing: Mexico is "not anyone's piñata."

• "We have to reserve the right" to act militarily
• "We would take military action if we feel like we have to protect our people"
• Vance frames cross-border strikes as US "self-defense"

🇲🇽📉 BBVA SLASHES MEXICO 2026 GDP FORECAST TO 1.2% — SPANISH BANK PLAYS DOWNGRADE GAME WHILE EXPORTS BREAK RECORDS

Spanish bank BBVA cut its 2026 Mexico GDP growth forecast from 1.8% to 1.2% on June 18, citing weaker investment and consumption. Chief economist Carlos Serrano warned Mexico 'could lose investment grade' status without a 0.9% fiscal surplus. Same bank's Saidé Salazar conceded the economy moves 'a tres velocidades' with exports remaining 'resilient' — Mexico still exports 664.84 billion USD globally, ranking 11th worldwide.

The same IMD dropped Mexico seven places to 62nd in its 2026 World Competitiveness ranking — putting Singapore (single-party state) at #1 and Hong Kong (PRC SAR) at #2. Sheinbaum has already rejected the S&P downgrade rhetoric and called the BBVA-line economists 'wrong.' Record FDI, record remittances (19.676 bn USD Q1), peso at 17.20, record exports — but Madrid's banks pump out the 'Mexico is failing' narrative on cue.
